title: Access Climate Hazards Center Datasets
text: package can provide direct access CHC climate datasets terra::SpatRaster objects. useful working large spatial datasets custom extraction workflows. Raster values can extracted using functions terra package. Fetch CHIRPS data three points across Tapajós National Forest (Brazil) January 2017. resulting object contains daily values location can readily converted matrix data frame analysis. recommended workflow retrieve native raster products using get_chirps_raw(), get_chirts_raw(), get_chirts_era5_raw(), use terra package extraction spatial analysis.
code: library("chirps") library("terra")  dates = c("2017-11-15", "2017-11-20")  # CHIRPS v2 precipitation chirps_v2 = get_chirps_raw(dates = dates, version = "2.0")  # CHIRPS v3 precipitation chirps_v3 = get_chirps_raw(dates = dates, version = "3.0", type = "sat")  # CHIRTS-ERA5 minimum temperature tmin = get_chirts_era5_raw(dates = dates, var = "Tmin")  # CHIRTS-ERA5 maximum temperature tmax = get_chirts_era5_raw(dates = dates, var = "Tmax") lonlat = data.frame(lon = c(-55.0281, -54.9857, -55.0714),                     lat = c(-2.8094, -2.8756, -3.5279))  pts = vect(lonlat,            geom = c("lon", "lat"),            crs = "EPSG:4326")  rain = extract(chirps_v2, pts)

text: Provides access Climate Hazards Center (CHC) datasets including CHIRPS, CHIRPS v3, CHIRTS-daily, CHIRTS-ERA5. 'CHIRPS' data quasi-global (50°S – 50°N) high-resolution (0.05 arc-degrees) rainfall data set, incorporates satellite imagery -situ station data create gridded rainfall time series trend analysis seasonal drought monitoring. title: Get raw CHIRPS raster data — get_chirps_raw
text: function returns CHIRPS raster layers SpatRaster without extracting values, reshaping data, converting data frame. intended users need direct access original raster product custom spatial workflows. CHIRPS v3 (Climate Hazards Center Infrared Precipitation Stations) high-resolution (0.05°), quasi-global rainfall dataset spanning 60°N 60°S 1981 near-present. CHIRPS v3 combines satellite-based thermal infrared rainfall estimates -situ station observations produce gridded precipitation estimates land. Two daily products available: rnl Daily values derived using ECMWF ERA5 precipitation   partition pentadal CHIRPS totals daily amounts. sat Daily values derived using NASA IMERG precipitation   partition pentadal CHIRPS totals daily amounts. Additional information available : https://www.chc.ucsb.edu/data/chirps3 Daily product documentation: https://data.chc.ucsb.edu/products/CHIRPS/v3.0/daily/readme.txt

CHIRTS-daily (Climate Hazards Center Infrared Temperature Stations) quasi-global (60°S 70°N), high-resolution (0.05° × 0.05°) dataset daily maximum minimum temperatures covering 1983–2016. CHIRTS-daily combines monthly CHIRTS temperature fields daily temperature variability ERA5 reanalysis produce spatially detailed temporally consistent temperature record suitable monitoring climate variability temperature extremes. Daily maximum temperatures generated combining monthly CHIRTS temperature estimates daily ERA5 anomalies. Daily minimum temperatures subsequently derived using ERA5 diurnal temperature range. Additional information available : https://www.chc.ucsb.edu/data/chirtsdaily

title: chirps 2.0.0 (2026-06-23)

Added support CHIRPS v3, including daily rnl (ERA5-based) sat (IMERG-based) products. Added get_chirts_raw() access CHIRTS-daily maximum temperature, minimum temperature, relative humidity, heat index datasets raster objects. Added get_chirts_era5_raw() access CHIRTS-ERA5 daily temperature datasets extending 1980 near-present.
